title: Analeptic
summary: ANALEP'TIC, adjective Corroborating; invigorating; giving strength after disease. ANALEP'TIC, noun A medicine which gives strength, and aids in restoring a body to health after sickness; a restorative

inlines.v: ANALEP'TIC, adjective Corroborating; invigorating; giving strength after disease. ANALEP'TIC, noun A medicine which gives strength, and aids in restoring a body to health after sickness; a restorative.
